lines.1: It had been about a week since student-council work began.
lines.2: That alone had made my once-ordinary days hectic.
lines.3: And the problems weren't limited to the student council.
lines.5: Lately, I'd started running into her all the time.
lines.6: We used to be close, but after one fight our relationship became completely hostile.
lines.7: Being at the same school could only be called bad luck.
